title: 第1548章 无垠的虚空第1547章 无知己或虚空界主
content_zh:
昭光起剑，飘然宝剑在其光道本源的强化下，光耀至极：“虚空界主，很可惜现在的你只是一记手段，而非本人”
吞天真君手中凝聚否无物不吞之力，形成一个庞大的云团，“虚空界主，多说无益了，你不是凡通，凡通在我们心里早就死了，现在的你只是空活一副躯壳罢了，没有心，没有情，若是失去这股虚道力量，你什么都不是！”
“拿到这股力量（界外之道），你又会继续吞噬界外虚空，看来你的本体仍然寄居在无垠无界，一旦让你掌握完全的界外虚空，加上界外虚空取之不尽，用之不竭的数量，你会成为危害八大界不低于那创世的灾难，我一定会前来阻止你的”渡梦界主眼芒一闪，无数彩色梦境，就完全围拢住虚空界主。
“喂，徒儿们至于这样么，你们说这些话，为师真的很不爱听。昕梦你说一个畜生，怎么能和一个有远大抱负的天神比，这不是无稽之谈？煦和，失去虚空之力，我也并非一无是处，因为我还有许多其他的力量啊，当然现在的界外之力是我的重中之重，不要虚空之力也不会对我有很大影响，况且即使没有力量，我在脑力比拼上，依然是比你们在场的所有天神更聪明，我这个人，不断求索，集往先贤英杰优点，收拢十多位界主之长，恰逢又出生在近代，我没有俗人之欲与所求，只有纯粹的对（道）的追求，在这一点上，哪一个界主比的过我？”
虚空界主略显佝偻的身体笔挺起来，皱巴巴的老脸与皮肤立马变得冰清玉洁，白发飘飘九万丈，目光逼人不世颜，这才是他本来的样貌！
“昭光，现在就是我本人亲临了，其实呢，我从来没有注意过自己的样貌，那些欺骗你们的假身份，也让你们大有成长，这不可否认吧”虚空界主说随，只一瞬间，整个青天世界像是突然全部置身在虚空当中，成挚等人完全傻眼，他们万人之众的天神，像是石像一般不能动弹，不能接触，而在他们身边的其他天神全部消失，最后在虚空当中，只有他自己一个人，仿佛完全被与世隔绝。
无垠的虚空，像是另一个死寂的八大界，昭光三人的攻势，好似全部扑空，而虚空界主反而悠然的站在他们面前，像是一位老师，开始训斥学生，他忽然长吟道——
改天意，避因果，无人知道今是我。
十方天地天外天，天外天上有神仙。
神仙有尽道无尽，吾身无拘亦无穷。
变规则，换历史，谁胜谁负由谁说。
曾经布局谋界外，凡通之后收三徒。
只手遮天虚空浑，荒芜展翅兆方圆！
所有沉寂的天神都听见了，甚至看到了正在他们所有人面前平静踱步的虚空界主！
“你弄这些障眼法，可以欺骗他们，却欺骗不了我，这虚空，只是源自于每一个人内心的空洞（各种遗憾，负面心情与记忆，渴求的事物与无尽的欲望），空洞越大，陷进去的时间就越快，这记手段，确实是生前的你布置的，界主以下，挡不住”渡梦界主道。
“昕梦，为师等着你来阻止，这个时代，也只有你有这个能力了，可十大帝器修补到关键时期，你真的会有这个时间吗”
昭光与吞天真君被虚空界主手段困住，和其他天神一样无法动弹，这时候渡梦界主指尖晕开无数梦道之力，梦道之力，充盈着无垠的虚空，并迅速取代虚空的空间与色彩，不仅是他们俩人，还是其余的天神，一并从死寂中缓过神来。
虚空界主的手段结束消失，全部天神回归到正常的青天世界，刚才众神面对真正的界主出手，他们没有一点反抗的能力，成挚等八位长老，也是第一次感受到界主的恐怖，哪怕只是一记手段，都令他们无从防御，若不是渡梦界主，谁知道虚空界主会不会灭杀他们。
“没有想到，我与师弟竟然被他强行控制了，在师妹面前丢人了”吞天真君道。
“帽子戏法，他只是在庆祝自己的喜悦，而拖延时间罢了，在过几刻，我就能破开他所设的虚妄”昭光不屑与讨厌道。

“这个孩子，身中虚空之力本源的无尽破坏，现在又在身体与灵魂上间接死亡，想要稳住他，令他重新活过来，必需要用以同样的门道本源扼制住虚空本源的侵蚀”渡梦界主出手，梦道力量破茧成蝶飞向他转死为生，应无悔的死亡，被梦境所平替取代，而在现实当中，他就真的好像做了一场自己死去的梦，那个自己死在了梦中。
“昭光师兄，应无悔的身体里，有你的光道本源，我无法为他施加梦道本源对抗虚空本源，他的身体会直接排斥，必需用你的光道本源……但是这样以来，师兄，你的命运就与他彻彻底底的挷定了”渡梦界主为昭光的自由所考虑，他生前是那么一个傲骄傲气十足的天神，他真的会把自己的一切托付给他人吗？
“昕梦师妹，让我来吧，就算我欠他的，他这数十年一路上的成长，我确实没有帮助他几次，反而是他很努力的在收集光之碎片与要复活我的仙材，唉，现在他对我猜忌，对所有人不信，对这世界永远只看到阴暗的一面，我占主要责任，可若是他不变成这样，他不一定能够活到现在，他的心里依旧有一抹明亮的光，虽然封闭情感，令自己纯粹为了利益而活的冷漠，然就像他不会放弃琉璃一样，应无悔始终是一位有情感的人，而非是完全没有情义之辈”昭光化为一缕耀眼的阳光，没入到应无悔的死亡的仙景心脏处，重新让其跳动和焕发生机。
“应无悔，我可不允许你这就放弃了。”
应无悔消散的灵魂重新凝聚，已死亡的僵化的身体又有了温度，他听到了昭光的呼唤。
原本应无悔即便是死了，他依然可以通过灵魂转换，让自己重新活在分身身上，只不过是虚空本源的不断侵蚀破坏，他的灵魂转换会受到极大阻碍，虽然分身也是他自己的灵魂与意志，可是没有本体本源灵魂授意，分身会缺少许多应无悔生前记忆与大量的手段，而且主体的意志与灵魂本源，若是连带着分身无法招架虚空本源的破坏，那么就连分身也会死亡，所以应无悔还是主动放弃了主体意志与灵魂本源与分身的转换，这样来说，本体死亡，分身之中，又会有新的应无悔本体产生，这便是应无悔即使死亡，还有的最大后手保障。
content_en:
Zhaoguang raised his sword, and the floating sword, strengthened by the source of its light path, shined extremely brightly: "Lord of the Void Realm, it's a pity that you are just a means, not yourself."
Lord Tun Tianzhen gathered the power of swallowing everything in his hands, forming a huge cloud, "Lord of the Void Realm, it is useless to say more, you are not an ordinary person, ordinary people have died in our hearts long ago, and now you are just a hollow body, with no heart and no emotion. If you lose this power of the void, you are nothing!"
"With this power (the way outside the world), you will continue to devour the void outside the world. It seems that your body still resides in the boundless world. Once you master the complete void outside the world, plus the inexhaustible quantity of the void outside the world, you will become a disaster that harms the eight worlds no less than the creation. I will definitely come to stop you." The eyes of the Lord of the Dream Realm flashed, and countless colorful dreams completely surrounded the Lord of the Void World.
"Hey, disciples, what's this? I really don't like hearing what you say. I really don't like hearing what you say. Xinmeng, you said how can a beast compare with a god with lofty ambitions? Isn't this nonsense? Xun He, I am not useless after losing the power of the void, because I have many other powers. Of course, the power outside the world is my top priority now, and I can't do it without the power of the void. It has a great influence on me. Moreover, even if I have no power, I am still smarter than all the gods here in the mental competition. I am a person who keeps searching, gathering the advantages of the sages and heroes, and gathering the strengths of more than a dozen realm masters. I happened to be born in modern times. I have no secular desires and desires, only the pure pursuit of (Tao). At this point, which realm master can compare with me? "
The Lord of the Void Realm's slightly rickety body straightened up, his wrinkled old face and skin immediately became as pure as ice, his white hair fluttered 90,000 feet, and his eyes were astonishingly beautiful. This is his true appearance!
"Zhaoguang, I am here in person now. In fact, I have never paid attention to my appearance. Those false identities that deceive you have also made you grow a lot. This is undeniable." The Lord of the Void Realm said, and in just a moment, the entire Qingtian World seemed to be suddenly at a loss. Being in the void, Cheng Zhi and others were completely dumbfounded. The gods among them were like stone statues, unable to move or touch, and all the other gods around them disappeared. Finally, he was the only one in the void, as if completely isolated from the world.
The boundless void was like another eight dead realms. The offensives of Zhaoguang and the others seemed to be all in vain, but the Lord of the Void Realm stood leisurely in front of them, like a teacher, and began to reprimand his students. He suddenly chanted -
Change God's will, avoid cause and effect, no one knows who I am now.
There are gods in the heavens and earth in the ten directions, and there are gods in the heavens beyond.
The immortals are boundless and their ways are endless, and my body is unfettered and endless.
Change the rules, change the history, who will decide who wins and who loses.
He once planned a plan outside the boundary, and after Fan Tong accepted three disciples.
A hand covers the sky, the sky is empty, and the desolation spreads its wings to signify the surrounding area!
All the silent gods heard it, and even saw the Lord of the Void pacing calmly in front of them all!
"You can deceive them with these tricks, but you can't deceive me. This void only comes from the void in everyone's heart (all kinds of regrets, negative moods and memories, longing for things and endless desires). The bigger the void, the faster it takes to fall into it. This trick was indeed arranged by you during your lifetime. Below the realm master, there is no way to stop it," the dream master said.
"Xinmeng, my master is waiting for you to stop me. In this era, you are the only one who has this ability. But the repair of the ten imperial weapons is at a critical stage. Do you really have this time?"
Zhaoguang and Lord Tun Tianzhen were trapped by the Void Realm Lord's means, unable to move like other gods. At this time, the Dream Realm Master's fingertips fainted the power of countless dream paths. The power of the dream path filled the boundless void, andThe space and color that quickly replaced the void caused not only the two of them, but also the other gods to recover from the deathly silence.
The Void Realm Lord's methods ended and disappeared, and all the gods returned to the normal world of blue sky. Just now, when the gods faced the real Realm Lord, they had no ability to resist. Cheng Zhi and other eight elders felt the terror of the Realm Lord for the first time. Even a single trick left them unable to defend themselves. If it weren't for the Dream Realm Lord, who knew whether the Void Realm Lord would kill them.
"I didn't expect that my junior brother and I would be forcibly controlled by him, and we would be embarrassed in front of our junior sister," Lord Tun Tianzhen said.
"Hat trick, he is just celebrating his joy and delaying time. In a few moments, I will be able to break the illusion he set up," Zhaoguang said with disdain and disgust.
"This child, the endless destruction of the source of void power in his body, is now indirectly dead in body and soul. If you want to stabilize him and make him come back to life, you must use the same doorway source to control the erosion of the void source." The master of the dream world took action, and the power of the dream path broke out of the cocoon and turned into a butterfly and flew to him to reincarnate from death to life. The death that should be without regrets was replaced by a dream. In reality, he really seemed to have had a dream of his own death, and that himself died in the dream.
"Senior Brother Zhaoguang, there is your light source in Ying Wuhui's body. I can't use the dream source on him to fight against the void source. His body will directly reject it, so I must use your light source... But from now on, senior brother, your fate is completely determined by him." The Lord of Dream Realm was concerned about Zhaoguang's freedom. He was such an arrogant god during his lifetime. Would he really entrust everything to others?
"Junior Sister Xinmeng, let me do it. Even if I owe him, I have not helped him a few times in his growth over the past few decades. Instead, he has worked very hard to collect the fragments of light and the fairy materials to resurrect me. Alas, now he is suspicious of me, distrusts everyone, and will always only see the dark side of the world. I am mainly responsible, but if he does not become like this, he may not be able to Living to this day, there is still a bright light in his heart. Although he has closed off his emotions and made himself indifferent to live purely for profit, just like he will not give up Liuli, Ying Wuhui has always been an emotional person, not a person who has no feelings at all." The light turned into a dazzling ray of sunshine and penetrated into the heart of Ying Wuhui's death fairy scene, making it beat and rejuvenate again.
"Ying Wugui, I won't allow you to give up now."
Ying Wuhui's dissipated soul regrouped and his dead, rigid body gained warmth again. He heard Zhaoguang's call.
Even if Ying Wuhui dies, he can still live in his clone body again through soul conversion. However, due to the constant erosion and destruction of the void source, his soul conversion will be greatly hindered. Although the clone is also his own soul and will, without the inspiration of the original soul of the original body, the clone will lack many memories of Ying Wuhui's lifetime and a large number of means, and If the main body's will and soul origin are unable to withstand the destruction of the void source, then even the clone will die. Therefore, Ying Wuhui voluntarily gave up on the transformation of the main body's will and soul origin and the clone. In this way, when the main body dies, a new Ying Wuhui's main body will be born among the clones. This is the biggest backup guarantee that Ying Wuhui still has even if he dies.
